verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, so user-configured background automations are a fair axis for it. The evidence does not document any such feature: the MCP tools are on-demand actions an external agent calls, which are developer building blocks rather than automations. The founder's mention of auto-categorization describes built-in behavior, not automations a user sets up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
